value.answer: Lowest 5-year fixed I could find today is about 4.34% for an insured mortgage (under 20% down), with a few lenders at that level. Uninsured is higher, around 4.64% at the low end. The big banks are more like 5.1 to 5.2%, and rates have been creeping up over the past few weeks. Depends on your down payment and which lender, though. What's your situation?
